# Protected selected direct MOVEs without ordinary numerical runtime

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0.
No new kappa. The five global selected assumptions remain.

## 1. Exact source statement and removed premise

Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.
Immediate public pins are the source-complete positive child
`12e58dfdad9371a26f9978c814779da344fd80b4` and the serial monomial
`2ec95e06c2a16e73f9da9a8fe41912710135daaf`. Their full trees were checked
against the frozen tested trees before reuse. The protected whole-field
coordinator and factor sources are retained transitively at their exact
public pins, including `41b67c290c1533de25bfba19d4dec27e1aaf0970`.

Fix any actual raw MOVE in the selected finite source family: 3453
occurrences and 2886 distinct directed chart pairs. Its genuine current-local
events are a right-monomial SERVICE, positive rank-r PAID, and left-monomial
SERVICE, with 1<=r<=8. The unchanged typed binder checks the entire raw source
record, owner, rank and chronological triple. Nested remap/product tokens
are not stripped or substituted. A source MOVE's boolean is a private-owner
lifetime flag, not a Fourier inverse flag.

On the domain below, `DirectMove` implements this complete raw MOVE using
the actual right monomial serialized into genuine one-column calls, the
rank-scaled positive C child, and the actual left monomial serialized in the
same way. It invokes no ordinary numerical runtime entry. The original
complete field is protected until all factors return and then committed.

This removes the monomial ordinary **runtime numerical/rate contract** from
this direct route. It retains finite closed ordinary constructors and all
their allocated ports, physical permutation/phase/codec primitives, supplied
source placement, complete costs and source-to-machine premises. No nonleaf
tariff, global cutoff admission or full compiler/multiplication theorem is
deduced from this construction.

## 2. Quantified parent geometry and numerical domain

The original canonical current descriptor has positive f,K,G,H,outer,rows,
0<=rho<K, source monomial rank nine, and remainder e with 0<=e<9. Write
u=active_start, z=back_start, a=within_bits. Retain

    (f-1)G<=H,  2H<=u,  u+9fK<=z,  z+H<=a,
    selected_axes=9f+e<=d.

Each complete row has 2^a records, each with c>=1 complex coefficients and
h>=2 signed bits per real/imaginary component on one common quantum. The
current format has a delimiter after each component and three physical bits
per virtual symbol, so

    b=record_bits=6c(h+1),  row_bits=2^a b,
    C=outer*rows,  V=C*2^a b.

Every original field/header/owned segment is genuinely disjoint with its
supplied LEFT marker and origin head. The whole protected stage and all
private bodies begin physically blank; old erased backing stays allocated.
Object-identity checks do not establish disjointness for arbitrary custom
physical port objects. These are normalized local source positions, not a
proof that an enclosing caller produced them.

The actual direct-leaf stopping condition is **r*f<=original cutoff**.
Cutoff is unchanged by every view. All intermediate serialized signed phases
must be representable; every actual C-stage Gaussian halving must be exact
on the common grid, and every C-stage output component must fit the signed
range. The final answer fitting alone does not establish this domain.

A useful sufficient uniform domain is: every input integer component is
divisible by 2^(r*f) and has absolute value strictly less than
2^(h-r*f-1). Each monomial address permutation/quarter rotation preserves
divisibility and absolute component magnitude. Each positive C stage spends
one divisibility bit and multiplies the maximum component magnitude by at
most two. Induction over r*f stages gives exact halves and strict symmetric
headroom throughout, including every exit column's signed phase. The
inherited fused arithmetic kernel's intermediate representation is retained.

The exact prefix-admitted domain is larger than this sufficient envelope.
The nonzero Gaussian-character h=2 finite fixture belongs to that larger
domain: its actual halves are exact and all components stay in {-1,0,1}.
It does not satisfy input divisibility by two and is not described as a
test of the stronger sufficient envelope.

The serial success domain is genuinely narrower than the original batched
monomial's domain. A cancelling batch phase can accept the most-negative
signed value while an intermediate serial negation cannot. The serial
predecessor proves and executes that obstruction. No equality of the two
acceptance domains is used here.

## 3. Three exact consumer views and complete operator identity

The parent's source positions are

    p_(i,j)=u+(if+j)K+rho,  0<=i<9, 0<=j<f.

Each serial monomial uses its own 45-port physically encoded descriptor
iterator. At column j it supplies only its actual monomial consumer with

    f'=1, K'=fK, rho'=jK+rho, selected_axes'=9+e,

leaving the other 19 fields unchanged. Then
u+iK'+rho'=p_(i,j), and 0<=rho'<K'. The compact width becomes zero, the
before/after intervals stay valid, and folding the entire suffix into extra
coefficient fields preserves every one of the original V physical bits.
The view is never passed to an ordinary provider or to the positive child.
It need not satisfy unused global producer relations.

The actual unchanged monomial engine computes n=f'-1=0 and selects its
`single_column_rows` branch at every affine gate. That branch and its signed
phase/format/cleanup work invoke no ordinary runtime call. Both serial
providers are constructed and bound once, then reused across all f columns;
no reset, fresh inventory or data-dependent host loop bound is introduced.
The literal iterator's ready/finished results drive the loop physically.

The middle positive child uses its separate 39-port leaf-only view

    f_child=r*f,

preserving the original cutoff and other 22 values. Its selected axes
u+kK+rho, 0<=k<r*f, are exactly p_(i,j) for i<r and j<f. This view is not a
general native descriptor and never reaches either monomial. The positive
kernel is exactly

    C_1 = 1/2 [[1+i,1-i],[1-i,1+i]].

It applies C_1 on each selected axis and identity on every complete spectator,
row and coefficient. Parent geometry gives u+r*f*K<=a, and the physical leaf
checks the actual r*f cutoff.

For each column, the fixed-source certificate proves

    U = M_left (C_1^(tensor r) tensor I_(9-r)) M_right

including absolute phase. Different columns act on disjoint tensor factors,
so the two serialized monomials and the multi-axis positive child compose
to U^(tensor f), tensored with identity on every other coordinate and label.
Each monomial's constant phase occurs once per column; no i^(f*c) is replaced
by i^c. The public all-source package independently checked all 2886 finite
chart identities using 18 Pauli conjugations and all 512 entries of one
normalized separating column. Its commutant lemma fixes the entire matrix.
We reuse that exact finite certificate, not a new general compiler theorem.
The arbitrary-f assertion follows from this separate tensor/view argument.

## 4. Whole-field protection and named returned failures

The coordinator first copies all V physical body bits to one blank private
stage. Entrance, child and exit receive that stage; the public original is
unchanged. Their numeric adapters preserve the complete coded format, size,
component quantum and row/spectator order. The parent header is read-only.

On success all three complete factors return, then the unchanged published
`AtomicMove.commit` copies the complete result to the public field. Finally
the stage is erased and returned to origin. Each serial descriptor bank,
native bank and child/view cohort has already been closed and retired.

A serial factor may have completed earlier columns before a later named
signed rejection. This changes only the private stage. The serial source
returns its descriptor, all working heads and a valid complete field extent
at the source boundary. The positive leaf has its corresponding valid
parity/headroom/cutoff return contract. Therefore a named valid returned
failure skips commit and retires the complete stage, preserving the original
public field and parent header. Child-local rollback alone would not establish
this property; the paid whole-field stage is essential.

This is not a guarantee for physical interruption, malformed streams,
unexpected corrupt successful output or a provider violating its inherited
return contract. In particular, the protected copy precedes the try/finally
just as in its predecessor and requires the stated valid blank-stage domain.

The raw-bit loops have unchanged exact action counts:

    transfer = 8V+14,  commit = 9V+14,  retire = 5V+7.

Thus administrative overhead is 22V+35 on success and 13V+21 on a named
valid returned failure. Both invoices add every executed provider action,
descriptor operation, failed scan, return and retirement; no earlier column
or partially attempted factor becomes free.

## 5. Optimistic and actual complete budgets

Let F_template include fixed source authentication/binding, finite recipe
compilation and table construction, real closed ordinary constructors, fixed
bank reservation and template storage. Let P_R,j and P_L,j be the complete
unchanged one-column monomial costs, including their codec, full-field copies,
phase/permutation work, encoded controls and cleanup. Let H_R,H_L be the two
literal descriptor-loop costs, and let T_C be the complete positive-leaf bill.
The successful composed invoice is

    F_template + H_R+H_L + sum_(j=0)^(f-1)(P_R,j+P_L,j)
               + T_C(V,h,r*f,E_child) + H_child + 22V+35.

The serial predecessor proves H_R+H_L=O_9(f(E+1)); the positive view has
E_child<=E+6 and H_child<=1000E+10000. These descriptors are constructed,
iterated, restored and erased physically. They are not free rebinding of
host parameters.

For comparison with the explicit inherited one-column ceiling, write

    R1=2hc*2^(a-z),  M1=C*2^z,  Vraw=M1*R1,
    A1=2+z+ceil(log2(R1+1)),

and let g_R,g_L count the finite affine gates in the two actual recipes.
The complete upper bound retains

    F_template
      + O_9(f*((g_R+g_L+2)*(Vraw+M1*A1^6)
                   + V+(E+1)^4+Q_R+Q_L)
             + r*f*V+(E+1)^4+388) + 22V+35.

No ordinary numerical tariff is subtracted from an unrelated bound. Under
the additional explicit long-record condition R1>=A1^6 and control absorption
`(E+1)^4+Q_total=O(V)`, fixed source ranks/gates give
`F_template+O(fV)`. If either condition fails, the larger displayed bound
remains. The finite complete-MOVE fixture uses the latter regime and does
not demonstrate long-record absorption. Neither regime implies the faster
nonleaf native tariff or a larger complete multiplication kappa.

If Q_R,Q_L are the actual finite monomial cohort sizes, the total inventory is

    Q_total = 1+(45+Q_R)+388+(45+Q_L) = 479+Q_R+Q_L.

For the documented real q2/capacity64 closed constructors, Q_R=Q_L=1878 and
Q_total=4235. Larger constructors change that number and remain charged.
An ordinary object being unused at runtime does not remove its tapes or
initialization from the inventory.

## 6. Complete historical backing

The protected stage retains its supplied origin prefix and at most
1+max V body/frontier cells across all calls. Each positive-header role
retains at most 2*max E+1 body/frontier cells, as proved by its predecessor.
Each of the two serial banks has 45 roles with O_9(max E+1) retained
body/frontier bounds from the literal iterator proof. Their sum, not the
largest active header, is charged.

Add the complete inherited retained backing of both monomial native cohorts,
the 349-role positive numeric cohort, original public fields/parent headers,
all parked caller ancestors and fixed template/source storage. For each
physical role take its maximum over the entire call and column history before
summing roles. Completed blank cohorts remain allocated, and different roles
may attain their maxima on different columns or calls. Nothing is reset or
deallocated between the f monomial calls.

The array-tape trace reports materialized role extents, which can differ from
visited blank addresses. A conservative visited bound adds initially supplied
regions and origins to the literal action count, since a unit move exposes
at most one new address. Those observations do not replace the source space
proof or establish a global caller stock bound.

## 7. Exact limits and open next questions

This is a source-level fixed-inventory construction for actual raw direct
MOVEs. It reuses unchanged factors and source certificates; it does not
materialize an enclosing source_ir.product/remap fragment, prove the global
descriptor producer, or flatten all numeric control into lifecycle tables.
The elementary r*f cutoff and precision/stock prerequisites still need to
be established at an actual complete multiplication caller.

The next useful obligations are a verified produced parent/placement and
typed enclosing occurrence; literal lifecycle export of this complete numeric
service; and a global argument admitting cutoff, common grid, headroom and
long-record/control costs in the selected recurrence. These are distinct
from the removed ordinary numerical runtime premise. All five foundational
assumptions remain; no new kappa or unconditional theorem is claimed.
